attchmntText: Hexagon Nutrition Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 16, 2026, titled "Earnings Release for the Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026".
voiceSummary: Hexagon Nutrition Limited filed an earnings release for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Listing Regulations. The company reported revenue from operations of Rs. 214.0 crore for H1 FY27, up 27.3% from Rs. 168.0 crore in H1 FY26. Gross profit rose 15.0% to Rs. 97.4 crore. EBITDA grew 1.6% to Rs. 22.7 crore with a margin of 10.6%. Profit after tax stood at Rs. 16.2 crore, with a PAT margin of 7.6%. For Q2 FY27, revenue was Rs. 109.7 crore, up 15.2% year-on-year. EBITDA was Rs. 10.9 crore with a margin of 9.9%. Profit after tax for the quarter was Rs. 8.2 crore. The disclosure is available on the company website at www.hexagonnutrition.com.

attchmntText: Hexagon Nutrition Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication-Q2 Results
voiceSummary: Hexagon Nutrition Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper publication of its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results during a meeting held on 14th November 2026. The advertisement was published in the Financial Express and Mumbai Lok Satta on 14th November 2026. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, the consolidated total income was 2,187.72 million rupees, with a net profit after tax of 165.92 million rupees. The standalone total income for the same period was 2,120.96 million rupees, with a profit after tax of 196.57 million rupees. The results are available on the company website.

attchmntText: Hexagon Nutrition Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Hexagon Nutrition Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 14, 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter was 1,038.25 million rupees, with a net profit of 98.23 million rupees. For the half year, revenue from operations was 2,052.27 million rupees, and net profit was 196.57 million rupees. Basic earnings per share for the quarter was 0.88 rupees, and 1.70 rupees for the half year. The trading window for directors and designated persons is open until 48 hours after the declaration of these results. The auditor's review report noted the merger of Hexagon Nutrition Exports Private Limited and the conversion of compulsorily convertible preference shares into equity shares.
